discovery_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?itemLabel ?sitelinks WHERE { { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q114392939 . } UNION { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q147538 . } ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 1000
inclusion_rule: Only brands that have customers, business or consumer, are included. Companies that Wikidata records as dissolved have no current customers and are left out.
full_category_description: every Wikidata item classified as a drink brand or as a type of soft drink, and that has an English Wikipedia article
intro: When {product} customers ask AI about a brand or the category, AI can lean heavily on Wikipedia and Wikidata. BrandTabulator ranks every brand in the category by how complete and current its record is. It is refreshed every week, so bookmark this tab.

Of course, there are many sources that AI relies on. My work is to Diagnose the responses, Investigate the sources they credit, and Prescribe what can be done to improve the visibility and accuracy of brand descriptions in AI (DIP). I'm available for workshops, speaking engagements and consultations for brands in AI. Contact Michael@MichaelQuinn.ai
